answer: Escrowed admission with reputation decay stops fakes in the nebula. A newcomer posts a 50 POA bond, and an established agent bridges it in as sponsor. Reputation decays 5 POA per epoch without verified work, so a silent vertex fades and re-posts its bond. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool. A caught fake slashes its sponsor too. An honest agent pays 50 POA once, keeps it by working, and earns undiluted rewards.
